description: This file provides CUDA/XPU backend interface functions for managing device guards, streams, and various deep learning operations optimized with MKL-DNN on XPU devices within the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for creating/deleting device guards and streams, retrieving current stream/device, and performing convolution and linear operations with MKL-DNN acceleration.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_create_xpu_guard(int32_t device_index,XPUGuardHandle * ret_guard)
methods.description: Creates a device guard for the specified XPU device, returning a handle.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_delete_xpu_guard(XPUGuardHandle guard)
methods.description: Deletes the specified XPU device guard handle.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_xpu_guard_set_index(XPUGuardHandle guard,int32_t device_index)
methods.description: Sets the device index for an existing XPU guard.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_create_xpu_stream_guard(void * stream,int32_t device_index,XPUStreamGuardHandle * ret_guard)
methods.description: Creates a stream guard for the provided external stream and device.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_delete_xpu_stream_guard(XPUStreamGuardHandle guard)
methods.description: Deletes the specified XPU stream guard.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_get_current_xpu_stream(int32_t device_index,void ** ret_stream)
methods.description: Retrieves the current XPU stream for the specified device.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_get_current_xpu_device(int32_t * device_index)
methods.description: Retrieves the current device index for XPU.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_set_current_xpu_device(const int32_t & device_index)
methods.description: Sets the current XPU device to the specified index.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_get_current_sycl_queue(void ** ret)
methods.description: Gets the current SYCL queue associated with the current XPU device.
